chunks: “The qunut on the Day of Jumu‘ah is the glorification of Allah, salat upon the Prophet of Allah, and the words of relief.”

key_terms.الصَّلَاةُ عَلَى نَبِيِّ اللَّهِ: sending blessings upon the Prophet of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم
key_terms.اَلْقُنُوتُ: the supplication recited in a standing posture during salat
key_terms.تَمْجِيدُ اللَّهِ: glorifying and magnifying Allah in devotional speech
key_terms.كَلِمَاتُ الْفَرَجِ: phrases of relief and deliverance recited as supplication
key_terms.يَوْمِ الْجُمُعَةِ: the day of Friday, distinguished for communal worship

ai.seo_question: What should be recited in the qunut on Friday according to Imam al-Baqir عليه السلام?
ai.summary: Imam Muḥammad ibn ‘Alī al-Bāqir عليه السلام describes the content of qunut on the Day of Jumu‘ah as comprising praise of Allah, salat upon the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم, and words of relief. The report highlights a recommended devotional form within prayer and points to a specific supplication to be recited thereafter.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.1404 - Imam Muhammad ibn Ali Al-Baqir (as) said:
"The Qunoot (supplication during prayer) on the Day of Jumu’ah consists of glorifying Allah (swt), sending blessings upon the Prophet of Allah (swt), and words of relief (Kalimatu-l-Faraj)”.
